candidates.name: Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis
support_spans: histopathologic analysis showed diffuse necrotizing granulomatous inflammation and fungal elements
Methenamine silver staining revealed yeast-like structures associated with septate hyphae demonstrating acute-angle branching
candidates.why: The presence of fungal elements and septate hyphae with acute-angle branching is characteristic of Aspergillus species, which is consistent with Invasive Pulmonary Aspergillosis.

candidates.name: Chronic Pulmonary Aspergillosis
support_spans: A chest radiograph demonstrated multiple nodules and masses of various sizes in both lung fields, some with cavitation
Chest CT (lung window) showed cavitary and noncavitary nodules and masses with faint surrounding ground-glass opacity (“halo sign”)
cavitary lesions had thick, irregular walls with septa-like structures
candidates.why: The presence of multiple nodules and masses with cavitation, and the characteristic 'halo sign' on CT, are consistent with Chronic Pulmonary Aspergillosis.
